INVINCIBLE ADVANCED SHANTAK
CR 12/MR 6

XP 51,200
Invincible advanced shantak
CE Huge magical beast
Init +13; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +20

DEFENSE

AC 43, touch 27, flat-footed 30 (+13 Dex, +6 mythic, +16 natural, –2 size)
hp 179 (11d10+119)
Fort +16, Ref +20, Will +9; second save
Defensive Abilities block attacks, hard to kill, slippery; DR 10/epic; Immune cold, disease; Resist acid 15, electricity 15, fire 15

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., fly 250 ft. (average)
Melee bite +24 (2d6+15), talon +24 (1d8+15 plus grab)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks mythic power (6/day, surge +1d8)

TACTICS

During Combat The shantak continues attacking until the gondola is destroyed, effectively leaving the PCs in the void of space.

STATISTICS

Str 41, Dex 36, Con 28, Int 12, Wis 22, Cha 16
Base Atk +11; CMB +28 (+30 bull rush, +32 grapple); CMD 51 (53 vs. bull rush, 55 vs. grapple)
Feats Awesome Blow, Flyby Attack, Hover, Improved Bull Rush M, Power Attack M, Wingover
M Mythic feat
Skills Acrobatics +13 (+9 to jump), Escape Artist +21, Fly +23, Intimidate +14, Perception +20; Racial Modifiers +8 Escape Artist
Languages Aklo
SQ no breath, share defenses, starflight
